new_material_candidates.name: Memory-R2: Fair Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Memory-Augmented LLM Agents
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Trains a persistent multi-session memory extractor and manager with explicit INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE operations and a long-horizon credit-assignment algorithm.

new_material_candidates.name: Memex(RL): Scaling Long-Horizon LLM Agents via Indexed Experience Memory
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Maintains compact structured summaries and stable indices while preserving full-fidelity interactions externally, and learns memory writing, indexing, and dereferencing behavior with reinforcement learning.

new_material_candidates.name: MemRL: Self-Evolving Agents via Runtime Reinforcement Learning on Episodic Memory
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Keeps the base LLM frozen while adapting episodic-memory utility from environmental feedback through semantic filtering followed by learned utility-based retrieval.

new_material_candidates.name: AtomMem: Learnable Dynamic Agentic Memory with Atomic Memory Operation
new_material_candidates.material_reason: Recasts memory management as a learned decision process over atomic Create, Read, Update, and Delete operations trained with supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.

reference_or_screened.name: SteeM — Steerable Memory Agent

reference_or_screened.reason: No official executable implementation was independently verified in this bounded pass, so reproducible claim-bearing eligibility is not established.
